origin: Frames from an actual native-algorithm offline replay of user-supplied basketball footage; not AI-generated images or live-phone screenshots.
method: Same source frame in all three panels. Full-frame detection output, standard crop, maximum crop. 100 ms simulated result-delivery delay, not measured phone latency. No manually completed trajectories.
limits: Selected examples are not an accuracy estimate. Small distant balls, occlusion, visual drift and mobile recording load remain unresolved. Production v3.4.16 does not contain AI tracking.
